verdict.early_builder_gate: PROVISIONAL USEFUL TONAL GAIN; continue only to bounded missing-evidence review of this exact visual02, with no additional design variant.
verdict.relative_to_original: Small but specific whole-character gain under both supplied lights: broad cream/bronze front crown becomes cooler gray steel that integrates somewhat better with surrounding metal. The visible orange optic remains the focal point.
verdict.relative_to_visual01: The conspicuous polygon mosaic is removed in both lights. Continuous highlight/color transition is more coherent than visual01 and the tonal gain survives that correction.
verdict.meaningful_new_cost_in_supplied_builder_: No meaningful new optic/edge/stance loss is apparent. Bronze bordering remains visible and the cap is not a featureless black patch. The now very smooth surface remains blank and simplified; it does not acquire source plate segmentation, fine wear or fastener depth.
verdict.remaining_failure: Full source resemblance still fails as an acceptance claim: wide smooth roof, front slot/cavity beneath it, thick round optic surround, simpler bill-root/cheek returns and softer body armor still differ from source. These are not resolved by a continuous cap color.
verdict.scope: Builder canon view under two stated held lights only. Early development judgment, not three-era/rear/export/browser/source/owner acceptance or mechanical/material certification.

evidence.finding: Neutral visual02 keeps visual01 cooler crown tone, removes several large disconnected gray polygons on the upper-front surface, and retains a readable thin bronze edge and orange optic. Whole visual change remains confined in appearance to the cap.
Workshop repeats the same improvement. The warm highlight near rear/top and blue-gray front transition stay continuous rather than mosaic; near eye, bill edge and plated neck remain readable.

Locked canon, July head and First Choice source use layered swept crown boundaries, a narrow source-shaped brow, recessed enclosed optic and compound hooked bill/cheek forms. Visual02 still reads as a broad smooth helmet-like cap above a slot and a rounded eye surround; no source crown reconstruction is established.

Whole candidate body retains soft regular feather relief and comparatively sparse mechanical detail. Sources also use different era finish states, which the current Builder-only images cannot establish for Maker/Mechanic.
All15 frozen resources match exact manifest hashes/byte lengths and decode; all6 whole images are1280x853. Original bytes unmodified.

Actual material graphs/normal sources, payload/UV preservation, camera/light equality, opposite/rear continuity, remaining era appearances, GLB and browser response not inspected. No implementation cause inferred from the vanished polygon pattern.
